usageNotes: Use this to suspend (RAM-to-disk or RAM freeze) all running VMs on a node simultaneously — typical before node maintenance when a full shutdown is not desired and VMs should resume where they left off. Requires 'VM.PowerMgmt' on '/' or per-VM, plus 'VM.Config.Disk' and 'Datastore.AllocateSpace' for the state storage; ensure sufficient free space on the configured suspend storage before calling. Returns a task UPID string — poll the task API to confirm completion before proceeding with maintenance.

examples.summary: Suspend all VMs on node 'pve01' using up to 4 parallel workers

tips: Omitting 'vms' suspends every running VM on the node; pass a comma-separated VMID list to target specific guests only.
Suspend writes VM RAM state to disk — ensure the configured state-storage has free space equal to or greater than the combined RAM of all targeted VMs.
The returned UPID can be tracked via GET /nodes/{node}/tasks/{upid}/status to detect failures on individual VMs before starting maintenance.
KVM hardware-assisted suspend ('freeze') is faster than full hibernate but may not be supported by all guest OSes; verify guest tools are installed.
